headline: Guinea: PDI Gold Secures Bankan and Mansounia Permits for 463 Million Dollar Investment
summary: PDI Gold has obtained permits for the Bankan and Mansounia projects in Guinea, linked to an investment of $463 million.
why: Gold mining investments in West Africa affect gold supply and the fiscal revenues of host governments.
original_headline: Guinée : PDI Gold décroche les permis de Bankan et Mansounia pour un investissement de 463 millions de dollars
